name: Steed of Slaanesh

bonuses.name: Mount
bonuses.text: A Steed may be ridden by a Daemonette or mortal champion of Slaanesh. Both take their Turn together, using the Steed's movement, and each have their own Action. Rider and Steed may be targeted separately.

bonuses.name: Unholy Speed
bonuses.text: Steeds may move up to triple their Speed when charging, and both Steed and rider gain +2 bonus dice instead of +1 to their subsequent attack rolls.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear a Steed must pass a DN 3 Fear Test.

note: Entry heading is 'Seeker' (a Daemonette riding a Steed, p.101); the stat block printed is the Steed of Slaanesh. Lashing Tongue prints 'Inflict (Poison 6)', stored Inflict (Poisoned 6) per catalogue spelling.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
